title: The Honey Sweets on the Marble
youtube_title: The Honey Sweets on the Marble | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Waiting kindly is a way of taking care.
summary: At a cottage windowsill of jars, trays, and drying wool, Femi wants to check on a tray of honey sweets setting on marble before it is ready. With the ferryman nearby, Femi leaves it covered and does a quiet task instead, until it finishes in its own time.
